about: Sealed held-out set for CHW-203, written 2026-10-10 before any tiered-composer code existed and committed first. The author also built the composer, so this is held out by commit order, not blind. The implementation and its frameworks never read this file; only `kyber-genui bench --requests` reads it at eval time. Do not edit to improve a score; add a new sealed file instead.
